beats.text: How many close friends is normal? Fewer than you think.
In 2021, Americans were asked to count their close friends.
Each dot is one in a hundred people. Each step is how many friends they have.
Almost half have one to four. One in eight has none.
In 1990, a third had ten or more. Now, only thirteen percent.
If your circle feels small, you have the most common size there is.

sources: Survey Center on American Life (2021), The State of American Friendship: Change, Challenges, and Loss (American Perspectives Survey, May 2021): no close friends 12 %, one to four 48 %, ten or more 13 %; 1990 (Gallup): none 3 %, one to four 32 %, ten or more 33 % (via Euronews 15.02.2023 and WEF 2022). Five to nine = remainder (27 % / 32 %).
